name: MK Ultra
summary: **MK Ultra** is a [[kind:cultivar|hybrid]] bred by T.H. Seeds in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, crossing [[g13|G13]] with [[og-kush|OG Kush]]. Its name references the CIA's Cold War-era MKUltra mind-control program.
